title: Software Developer / Engineer
short_description: Designs, codes, tests, and maintains computer software, mobile applications, and system frameworks.
typical_activities: Writing modular and maintainable source code
Collaborating with product managers and UX designers
Debugging errors and refactoring legacy systems
Architecting scalable backend APIs and database schemas
preferred_work_environments: Office, laboratory, or remote digital environments
Structured yet creative technical workspaces

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science stream (PCM) or 3-year Polytechnic Diploma in Computer Engineering.
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science / IT or BCA followed by MCA or B.Sc in Computer Science.
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: M.Tech in CS/AI, specialized cloud/devops certifications, or direct industry placement.

minimum_prerequisites: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or demonstrable programming proficiency through projects.
typical_training: 3 to 6 months of continuous project-based coding, version control (Git), and software testing frameworks.
suggested_beginner_projects: Build a command-line student grade tracker or budget manager in Python
Create a responsive personal portfolio website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Develop a weather dashboard app that fetches live forecasts from an open API

title: Data Scientist & Machine Learning Specialist
short_description: Extracts actionable insights from complex datasets using statistical modeling, machine learning, and data visualization.
typical_activities: Cleaning and transforming massive unstructured data pipelines
Training predictive machine learning and deep learning models
Communicating mathematical findings to executive stakeholders
Building interactive data dashboards and KPI metric tracking systems
preferred_work_environments: Tech offices, research labs, or flexible remote setups
Working heavily with data and algorithmic ideas

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science stream (PCM) or Commerce with Mathematics.
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.Tech in CS/Data Science, B.Stat / B.Math (ISI), B.Sc in Statistics/Mathematics.
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: M.Sc in Data Science, M.Tech in AI, IIT Madras BS in Data Science, or specialized PG Diploma.

minimum_prerequisites: Undergraduate degree in quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Economics).
typical_training: Hands-on experience with Python (Pandas, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch), SQL, and statistical hypothesis testing.
suggested_beginner_projects: Analyze a public Kaggle dataset (e.g. Titanic survival or housing prices) using Pandas and Seaborn
Build a movie recommendation script using collaborative filtering
Create an exploratory dashboard visualizing city air quality trends over time

title: Information Security & Cybersecurity Analyst
short_description: Protects digital networks, servers, and sensitive information systems from cyberattacks, breaches, and unauthorized access.
typical_activities: Monitoring computer networks for security vulnerabilities and anomalies
Conducting penetration testing and ethical hacking simulations
Deploying firewalls, endpoint encryption, and multi-factor authentication
Developing incident response procedures and digital forensics reports
preferred_work_environments: Security Operations Centers (SOC), enterprise tech offices, or defense facilities

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science Stream (PCM) or Polytechnic Diploma in Computer/Network Engineering.
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.Tech in Cybersecurity / Computer Science or BCA with cybersecurity specialization.
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or M.Tech in Information Security.

minimum_prerequisites: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Forensics, or equivalent professional networking/security certifications.
typical_training: Lab training on packet sniffing (Wireshark), Linux hardening, and capturing flags in ethical hacking simulations.
suggested_beginner_projects: Set up a local virtualized Linux lab using VirtualBox and analyze open ports using Nmap
Write a Python script to verify password strength and check for common hashing vulnerabilities
Complete introductory web security challenges on free platforms like OverTheWire or PicoCTF

title: Mechanical & Robotics Engineer
short_description: Designs, analyzes, prototypes, and manufactures mechanical devices, automated robotics, automotive engines, and thermal systems.
typical_activities: Creating 3D parametric CAD models and finite element structural simulations
Prototyping automated robotic mechanisms and mechatronic actuators
Testing material fatigue, heat dissipation, and mechanical vibrations
Supervising manufacturing assembly lines and industrial production tooling
preferred_work_environments: Engineering design studios, fabrication workshops, testing laboratories, and manufacturing plants

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science Stream (PCM) or 3-year Polytechnic Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Robotics Engineering.
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: M.Tech in Machine Design / Robotics / CAD-CAM, or direct engineering consultancy.

minimum_prerequisites: Four-year Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related mechatronics field.
typical_training: Proficiency in CAD modeling tools (SolidWorks, AutoCAD), MATLAB/Simulink, and CNC workshop machinery.
suggested_beginner_projects: Design a 3D printable mechanical gear mechanism or phone stand using free Onshape or Blender
Build a microcontroller-powered line-following robot using Arduino and infrared sensors
Simulate heat transfer or stress analysis on a structural bracket using open-source CAE software

title: Civil & Structural Engineer
short_description: Plans, designs, and oversees construction of physical infrastructure including bridges, highways, water supply networks, and eco-friendly skyscrapers.
typical_activities: Calculating load-bearing structural capacities for reinforced concrete and steel
Evaluating geotechnical soil reports and foundation stability
Conducting environmental impact assessments for municipal transit projects
Supervising on-site construction safety, materials quality, and survey layouts
preferred_work_environments: Balanced between engineering design offices and active outdoor construction project sites

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science Stream (PCM) or 3-year Polytechnic Diploma in Civil Engineering.
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering.
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: M.Tech in Structural / Geotechnical / Transportation Engineering, or public works exams (ESE/UPSC).

minimum_prerequisites: Four-year Bachelor of Technology or Engineering in Civil Engineering.
typical_training: STAAD.Pro, ETABS, AutoCAD, total station surveying equipment, and construction project management tools.
suggested_beginner_projects: Construct a miniature popsicle-stick or balsa-wood truss bridge and test its structural load limit
Model a sustainable rainwater harvesting system for a residential school or community center
Draft a digital floor plan and structural layout for a single-story building using free 2D CAD

title: Electrical & Electronics Engineer
short_description: Designs, tests, and supervises the manufacture of electrical equipment, power grids, semiconductor circuits, and renewable energy conversion systems.
typical_activities: Designing printed circuit boards (PCBs) and micro-electronic systems
Developing smart power grid transmission algorithms and substation layouts
Testing electric vehicle (EV) battery management and motor drive electronics
Ensuring compliance with national electrical safety standards and electromagnetic shielding
preferred_work_environments: Electronics laboratories, power utilities, semiconductor fabs, and engineering design studios

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science Stream (PCM) or 3-year Polytechnic Diploma in Electrical / ECE.
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.Tech in Electrical Engineering (EE) or Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE).
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: M.Tech in VLSI Design / Power Systems / Embedded Systems, or GATE for PSU employment.

minimum_prerequisites: Four-year Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Instrumentation Engineering.
typical_training: Circuit simulation (SPICE, Proteus), microcontroller programming, and high-voltage safety protocols.
suggested_beginner_projects: Build a breadboard circuit containing a 555 timer chip and LEDs with adjustable pulse frequency
Create a solar cell charging station monitor using an Arduino and basic voltage divider
Design a custom PCB layout in KiCad for an audio amplifier circuit

title: General Physician / Medical Practitioner
short_description: Diagnoses, treats, and helps prevent illnesses and injuries in patients of all ages, promoting long-term community health and well-being.
typical_activities: Examining patients and recording medical histories and clinical symptoms
Ordering and interpreting diagnostic tests such as blood work, X-rays, and ECGs
Prescribing therapeutic medications, lifestyle counseling, and preventive vaccines
Referring patients with complex clinical conditions to medical and surgical specialists
preferred_work_environments: Hospitals, community primary health centers, and clinical consulting chambers
Compassionate, human-centered work

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science stream with Biology (PCB or PCMB).
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery) 5.5 years including 1-year internship.
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: MD in General Medicine / Family Medicine / Pediatrics, or public healthcare service.

minimum_prerequisites: MBBS degree recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and valid state medical council registration.
typical_training: One year compulsory rotatory residential internship in medicine, surgery, obstetrics, and community health.
suggested_beginner_projects: Complete a certified Red Cross or St. John Ambulance First Aid and CPR course
Conduct a school survey investigating adolescent hydration habits and sleep patterns
Volunteer at a local community health camp or blood donation drive to observe triage processes

title: Registered Clinical Nurse
short_description: Provides hands-on patient care, administers medication, operates life-monitoring medical equipment, and educates patients and families on disease management.
typical_activities: Administering intravenous medications and monitoring patient vital indicators
Coordinating holistic patient care plans with physicians and allied specialists
Operating intensive care cardiac monitors, ventilators, and infusion pumps
Providing compassionate physical comfort and psychological support to distressed families
preferred_work_environments: Hospital wards, intensive care units, emergency trauma suites, and outpatient clinics

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science Stream with Biology (PCB).
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.Sc Nursing (4 years) or GNM Diploma (General Nursing & Midwifery 3 years).
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: M.Sc Nursing (Cardiology, Critical Care, Oncology), or clinical nurse specialist roles.

minimum_prerequisites: Four-year B.Sc Nursing degree and registered nurse (RN/RM) credentials from State Nursing Council.
typical_training: Extensive clinical bed-side rotations across critical care, obstetrics, community nursing, and pediatrics.
suggested_beginner_projects: Learn and practice vital signs measurement (temperature, pulse, blood pressure, oxygen saturation)
Create a patient-friendly illustrated brochure on preventing seasonal vector-borne diseases like dengue
Volunteer with an elderly home or palliative care organization assisting with mobility support

title: Pharmacist & Clinical Pharmacologist
short_description: Formulates, dispenses, and assesses medications, advising healthcare practitioners and patients on drug dosages, interactions, and therapeutic efficacy.
typical_activities: Compounding and dispensing prescription pharmaceuticals accurately
Reviewing drug-to-drug interactions, contraindications, and patient allergy profiles
Conducting pharmaceutical bio-equivalence testing and clinical drug trials
Educating patients regarding proper drug administration and storage requirements
preferred_work_environments: Hospital dispensaries, pharmaceutical R&D labs, and community pharmacy centers

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science Stream (PCB or PCM).
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm 4 years) or Pharm.D (6-year clinical doctorate).
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: Master of Pharmacy (M.Pharm in Pharmacology / Pharmaceutics) or GPAT.

minimum_prerequisites: B.Pharm degree and registered pharmacist license from Pharmacy Council of India (PCI).
entrance_examinations: GPAT (Graduate Pharmacy Aptitude Test for M.Pharm)
typical_training: Clinical hospital training and industrial pharmaceutical manufacturing internships.
suggested_beginner_projects: Catalog common over-the-counter medications, their active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and uses
Research how antibiotics target bacterial cell walls without damaging human cells, producing a clear report
Prepare a safety guide for proper household disposal of expired pharmaceuticals

title: Biotechnologist & Genetic Scientist
short_description: Applies biological principles and cellular genetics to develop vaccines, genetically engineered crops, biofuels, and medical diagnostic therapies.
typical_activities: Performing DNA sequencing, CRISPR gene editing, and PCR amplification
Culturing microbial strains and optimizing bioreactor fermentation conditions
Analyzing genomic data using bioinformatics tools and protein structural modeling
Ensuring biosafety regulatory compliance during genetic modification trials
preferred_work_environments: Molecular biology laboratories, biopharmaceutical cleanrooms, and university research facilities

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science Stream with Biology (PCB or PCMB).
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.Sc or B.Tech in Biotechnology / Bioinformatics / Microbiology (3–4 years).
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: M.Sc / M.Tech in Biotechnology, followed by Ph.D. or industrial research position.

minimum_prerequisites: Bachelor's degree in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Genetics, or Life Sciences.
typical_training: Sterile cell culture handling, gel electrophoresis, spectro-photometry, and NCBI BLAST bioinformatics searches.
suggested_beginner_projects: Extract visible DNA strands from strawberries or bananas at home using salt, detergent, and chilled rubbing alcohol
Explore the NCBI GenBank database to compare insulin gene sequences between humans and other mammals
Write a short essay evaluating the ethical and ecological implications of CRISPR gene editing in agriculture

title: Chartered Accountant & Financial Auditor
short_description: Audits corporate financial statements, formulates taxation strategies, ensures regulatory statutory compliance, and advises on mergers.
typical_activities: Auditing corporate balance sheets, cash flows, and profit-and-loss disclosures
Advising corporations on Goods & Services Tax (GST), corporate tax, and cross-border transfer pricing
Evaluating internal financial controls and detecting corporate financial irregularities
Representing clients before regulatory tax appellate tribunals
preferred_work_environments: Chartered accounting audit firms, corporate finance headquarters, and consultancy offices

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Commerce Stream (with or without Mathematics).
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: Register for CA Foundation with ICAI while pursuing B.Com / B.Com (Hons).
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: Direct entry route into CA Intermediate for commerce graduates with 55%+ marks, followed by Articleship and CA Final.

minimum_prerequisites: Completion of ICAI Chartered Accountancy qualification (Foundation, Intermediate, 2-year Articleship, and Final Exam).
typical_training: Mandatory 2 years of practical articleship training under a practicing Chartered Accountant firm.
suggested_beginner_projects: Prepare a complete double-entry ledger, trial balance, and balance sheet for a hypothetical small retail shop
Analyze the publicly published annual financial report of a listed company (e.g. Tata Motors or Infosys)
Calculate personal income tax liability for different income slabs under India's new and old tax regimes

official_sources.name: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)

title: Investment Banker & Financial Analyst
short_description: Advises corporations and governments on raising capital, structuring mergers & acquisitions (M&A), and analyzing market equity investments.
typical_activities: Building discounted cash flow (DCF) and leveraged buyout (LBO) financial valuation models
Preparing confidential investment pitch books for initial public offerings (IPOs)
Conducting financial due diligence on acquisition targets
Presenting market valuation insights to corporate CFOs and institutional investors
preferred_work_environments: Investment banking offices, equity research institutions, and private equity firms

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Commerce with Math or Science Stream (PCM).
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.Com (Hons), B.A. Economics (Hons), B.Sc Finance, or B.Tech (Engineering).
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: MBA in Finance from top business school (IIMs, ISB, global top-20), CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) charter.

minimum_prerequisites: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, or Engineering with strong quantitative aptitude.
typical_training: Advanced financial modeling in Excel, Bloomberg Terminal navigation, and valuation methodologies.
suggested_beginner_projects: Construct a 3-statement financial model (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) for a company in Excel
Track a simulated portfolio of 5 stocks over 6 weeks and write a rationale explaining market movements
Summarize the strategic rationale and financial terms of a recent major corporate acquisition in the news

title: Management Consultant & Business Strategist
short_description: Helps enterprise executives solve complex organizational hurdles, optimize operational efficiency, and enter new market sectors.
typical_activities: Dissecting complex corporate client problems using structured hypothesis frameworks
Conducting stakeholder interviews, cost-benefit analyses, and industry benchmarking
Synthesizing actionable executive recommendations into persuasive presentation decks
Guiding change-management implementation alongside corporate executive teams
preferred_work_environments: High-energy corporate client offices, management consulting firms, and collaborative team rooms

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Any stream with strong analytical emphasis (Commerce with Math, Science, or Humanities with Economics).
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: Undergraduate degree in Engineering, Economics, Commerce, or BBA/BMS.
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: MBA from top-tier institution (IIMs, ISB, Ivy League) or direct campus hiring from premier undergraduate colleges.

minimum_prerequisites: Bachelor's degree with proven analytical excellence, problem-solving ability, and case interview performance.
typical_training: Structured case cracking, MECE problem decomposition, executive storytelling, and data synthesis.
suggested_beginner_projects: Crack and solve 3 business case studies (e.g. market entry or profitability drop) using structured frameworks
Formulate a strategic turnaround plan for a struggling local retail shop or restaurant
Create an executive slide deck proposing an expansion plan for an electric two-wheeler startup

title: Corporate Lawyer & Advocate
short_description: Advises clients on legal rights, drafts contracts, represents litigants in courtrooms, and ensures corporate compliance with statutory laws.
typical_activities: Drafting commercial contracts, non-disclosure agreements, and joint-venture terms
Conducting extensive precedent case-law research across digital legal databases
Formulating oral and written legal arguments for judicial benches and arbitration panels
Counseling corporate clients on regulatory antitrust, employment, and IP laws
preferred_work_environments: Law chambers, judicial courthouses, corporate legal departments, and arbitration centers

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Humanities, Commerce, or Science stream with strong reading and analytical focus.
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: Five-year integrated B.A. LL.B or B.B.A. LL.B from a National Law University (NLU).
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: Three-year LL.B after any bachelor's degree; LL.M. for academic or specialized corporate practice.

minimum_prerequisites: LL.B degree recognized by the Bar Council of India (BCI) and clearing the All India Bar Examination (AIBE).
typical_training: Participation in national moot court competitions, legal drafting workshops, and internships with advocates or law firms.
suggested_beginner_projects: Prepare a mock trial or moot court argument on an interesting constitutional free-speech or privacy scenario
Review the Terms of Service of a popular social media app and highlight clauses concerning user data rights
Summarize the majority and dissenting judgments of a landmark Supreme Court constitutional ruling

title: Civil Services Officer (IAS / IPS / State Administrator)
short_description: Administers district governance, formulates and executes public development policies, maintains law and order, and oversees civic services.
typical_activities: Directing district administration, revenue collection, and social development schemes
Responding to humanitarian disasters, flood management, and public emergency relief
Formulating policy white-papers for central and state government ministries
Engaging directly with citizens, public representatives, and local community panchayats
preferred_work_environments: District administrative collectorates, government secretariats, and active field inspection visits

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Any academic stream (Humanities, Science, or Commerce).
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: Undergraduate degree in any discipline (B.A., B.Sc, B.Com, B.Tech, MBBS, etc.).
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: UPSC Civil Services Examination (Prelims, Mains, and Interview) preparation.

minimum_prerequisites: Graduate degree in any discipline from a university recognized by UGC. Minimum age 21 years.
entrance_examinations: State Public Service Commission Exams (State PSC)
typical_training: Two years of probationary administrative and field training at LBSNAA (Mussoorie) and state academies.
suggested_beginner_projects: Select a government welfare program (e.g. Mid-Day Meal or Jal Jeevan Mission) and study its grassroots implementation in your area
Write a balanced 1000-word policy brief analyzing the pros and cons of an urban public transport policy
Participate in a Model United Nations (MUN) or Youth Parliament representing a ministerial portfolio

title: Clinical & Counseling Psychologist
short_description: Assesses and treats mental health disorders, emotional struggles, and behavioral issues through psychotherapy and psychometric assessments.
typical_activities: Conducting diagnostic clinical interviews and standardized psychometric testing
Delivering evidence-based psychotherapy (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Humanistic Counseling)
Formulating behavioral modification treatment plans for depression, anxiety, and trauma
Consulting with psychiatric doctors on holistic biopsychosocial interventions
preferred_work_environments: Clinical therapy consultation rooms, psychiatric hospitals, university counseling centers

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Humanities, Science, or Commerce stream.
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.A. or B.Sc in Psychology (3–4 years).
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: M.A./M.Sc in Clinical Psychology, followed by RCI-recognized M.Phil or Psy.D in Clinical Psychology for clinical licensure.

minimum_prerequisites: Master's degree in Clinical Psychology + RCI licensure (or Psy.D/M.Phil in Clinical Psychology) for independent clinical practice.
typical_training: Supervised clinical hospital residency with direct patient psychometric evaluation and psychotherapy cases.
suggested_beginner_projects: Design an educational school presentation debunking common myths and stigma around seeking mental health therapy
Keep a structured 14-day cognitive behavioral mood and gratitude journal to study personal cognitive patterns
Conduct a research survey investigating correlations between screen-time habits and self-reported sleep quality

title: UI/UX & Digital Product Designer
short_description: Designs intuitive, accessible digital interfaces and delightful user experiences for mobile apps, websites, and enterprise software.
typical_activities: Conducting user interviews, empathy mapping, and usability testing sessions
Creating low-fidelity wireframes and interactive high-fidelity clickable prototypes
Developing scalable design systems with reusable UI components and typography standards
Collaborating closely with frontend engineers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation
preferred_work_environments: Tech product companies, design studios, creative agencies, and remote collaborative teams

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Any stream with interest in visual arts, design, or computing.
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.Des (Interaction Design / Industrial Design) from NID/IITs or B.Tech / BCA with design portfolio.
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: M.Des from IDC (IIT Bombay) / NID, Google UX Design Certificate, or robust portfolio-driven entry.

minimum_prerequisites: Compelling design portfolio demonstrating user research, wireframing, and interactive design prototypes.
typical_training: Mastery of industry design tools (Figma, FigJam), user persona creation, accessibility (WCAG), and responsive layout.
suggested_beginner_projects: Audit a confusing real-world mobile app and redesign a cleaner 3-screen checkout flow in Figma
Build a complete design system with buttons, input fields, colors, and typography styles for a student app
Conduct a 5-person user testing session on a prototype and document actionable UX takeaways

title: Architect & Urban Designer
short_description: Conceives, designs, and plans aesthetic, sustainable, and functional buildings, residential complexes, and urban community spaces.
typical_activities: Drafting architectural blueprints, spatial layouts, and elevations
Incorporating solar passive architecture, natural ventilation, and green building norms (GRIHA/LEED)
Collaborating with structural engineers, landscape architects, and municipal authorities
Conducting on-site construction walkthroughs to verify structural adherence to blueprints
preferred_work_environments: Architecture design studios, client boardrooms, and outdoor construction project sites

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science Stream (PCM) - Mathematics is mandatory for Council of Architecture (CoA) eligibility.
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch 5 years).
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: M.Arch in Urban Design / Sustainable Architecture / Landscape Architecture, or Council registration.

minimum_prerequisites: Five-year B.Arch degree recognized by the Council of Architecture (CoA) and clearing NATA or JEE Main Paper 2.
typical_training: Architectural studio juries, physical scale model building, Building Information Modeling (BIM/Revit), and AutoCAD.
suggested_beginner_projects: Draw 1-point and 2-point perspective sketches of your room or school campus with accurate light and shadow
Design a zero-waste, energy-efficient eco-pavilion for a public park using cardboard scale modeling
Create a digital 3D model of a modern tiny-home using Trimble SketchUp free web edition

title: Investigative Journalist & Media Reporter
short_description: Investigates, reports, writes, and broadcasts news stories, holding public institutions accountable and informing civil society.
typical_activities: Investigating news leads, verifying source credibility, and cross-checking facts
Interviewing public officials, industry specialists, and eyewitnesses
Drafting compelling, clear, and impartial news articles under tight deadlines
Producing multimedia news packages, video reports, and digital podcasts
preferred_work_environments: Newsrooms, broadcast recording studios, and investigative field reporting locations

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Humanities, Commerce, or Science stream with strong language command.
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.A. in Journalism & Mass Communication (BJMC 3 years) or B.A. in English / Political Science.
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: PG Diploma in Journalism (IIMC, Asian College of Journalism) or M.A. in Mass Communication.

minimum_prerequisites: Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Mass Communication, or related field with published writing samples.
typical_training: Beat reporting, newsroom fact-checking, ethical journalism standards, audio/video editing, and libel laws.
suggested_beginner_projects: Write a 700-word investigative feature story on a civic issue (e.g. waste management or public transit) in your neighborhood
Conduct and record a 10-minute structured interview with a teacher or community leader on youth challenges
Launch a student digital newsletter or blog reporting on school events and student opinions

title: Agricultural Scientist & Agronomist
short_description: Researches crop productivity, soil health, pest management, and sustainable precision agriculture to ensure food security.
typical_activities: Conducting controlled field experiments on high-yield, drought-resistant crop varieties
Analyzing soil chemistry, nitrogen fixation, and microbial composition
Developing integrated pest management (IPM) protocols using organic biological controls
Advising agricultural cooperatives on drip irrigation and precision sensor deployment
preferred_work_environments: Agricultural research stations, field test farms, green-houses, and soil testing labs

possible_education_pathways.after_class_10: Science Stream with Biology or Agriculture (PCB/PCMB).
possible_education_pathways.after_class_12: B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture (4 years).
possible_education_pathways.after_graduation: M.Sc in Agronomy / Genetics & Plant Breeding / Soil Science, followed by ASRB Agricultural Research Service (ARS).

minimum_prerequisites: Four-year B.Sc (Hons) in Agriculture or related agricultural sciences recognized by ICAR.
typical_training: Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) semester, seed certification procedures, and soil spectro-photometry.
suggested_beginner_projects: Run a small home experiment comparing plant growth across different soil types (clay, sand, compost)
Build a simple low-cost gravity drip irrigation rig using recycled plastic bottles
Document native beneficial insects and pollinator species visiting a local garden over one week
